title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant D (display-typography amplification, static)

variant.role: one captured trait amplified (static composition bet)
variant.bet: Roboto Condensed CAPS promoted from h-tags-only into nav labels, primary CTA labels, section eyebrows, and key body callouts — type scope expansion
variant.capturedTraitAmplified: display-typography scope (currently confined to h1-h5; family + weight already pinned by brand)
variant.evidence: _brand-extraction.json#type.headingFamily — Roboto Condensed 700 at 18/20/22/29/30/40/42 px; voiceTable.toneMetrics 53% headings ALL-CAPS; voice.ctaSamples ALL-CAPS imperatives

differentiationFrom.A: A applies 1.250 modular scale across the captured 7 headings; D applies a larger 1.333 (perfect-fourth) display scale AND extends Roboto Condensed CAPS into nav + CTAs + eyebrows. 3 diffs: (1) type scale 1.250 vs 1.333, (2) nav rendered Roboto Condensed CAPS (not mixed-case captured), (3) primary CTA labels rendered Roboto Condensed 700 not Roboto.
differentiationFrom.C: C is kinetic-display cinematic motion layered on captured composition; D is static composition with display-type scope expansion. 3 diffs: (1) C has motion runtime + lenis; D has none. (2) C keeps captured ad-hoc sizes; D applies 1.333 modular scale. (3) C adds top signage marquee; D does not (static).

typographyScale.rationale: Perfect-fourth scale amplifies display-type as structural voice; the 1.250 of A (major-third) is too narrow for D's type-foregrounding bet. The ratio still respects density floor (sectionPadding 64px desktop) because vertical rhythm is independent of inline type scale.

typeScopeExpansions.rationale: D's bet — promote Roboto Condensed CAPS from heading-tag confinement to a structural voice across the page.

applications.from: Roboto 400 mixed-case (captured: 'Sponsorships' sentence case + 'NEW EQUIPMENT' all-caps inconsistently)
applications.to: Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS letter-spacing 0.04em — every link rendered as a typographic plate
applications.evidence: voice.navItems has mixed casing; the 53% all-caps headings rate signals the brand register tolerates this expansion

applications.from: Roboto 700 ALL-CAPS (captured: '.btn-yellow' uses workhorse Roboto for button labels)
applications.to: Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS — CTAs become the same display register as headings
applications.evidence: voice.ctaSamples (NEW QUOTE / SHOP USED / RENT NOW / CREDIT APP) are already imperative caps; condensed face strengthens the plate quality

applications.from: Roboto Condensed 400 18px letter-spacing 1.8px (captured: h4 eyebrow on finance slides)
applications.to: Roboto Condensed 700 12px letter-spacing 0.12em with hairline yellow underline — eyebrow as structural plate
applications.evidence: captured eyebrow weight was 400; weight up to 700 promotes the eyebrow from label to plate without inventing the family

applications.from: captured Roboto Condensed 700 large (e.g. '18' '75' '24' at hero scale)
applications.to: Roboto Condensed 700 tabular-nums 65px with a thin Roboto-Condensed 400 caps label inline ('18 BRANCHES · UT / AZ / NV / WY')
applications.evidence: tabular-nums available in Roboto Condensed; no font invention

applications.surface: footer headings (QUICK LINKS / CONTACT US / CONNECT WITH US)
applications.to: Roboto Condensed 700 21px letter-spacing 0.08em — footer headings as condensed-cap plates
applications.evidence: captured footer headings ARE all-caps; D upweights without re-typing

hero.headline: FINANCING DEALS & SPECIAL OFFERS rendered at 65px Roboto Condensed 700 with -0.005em letter-spacing — display-cap hero plate
hero.subhead: Roboto Condensed 400 21px ALL-CAPS letter-spacing 0.06em — subhead reads as a continuation of the display register, not a sentence-case break

financeBand.eyebrowTreatment: Roboto Condensed 700 12px caps with hairline yellow underline — see typeScopeExpansions[eyebrow]
financeBand.rationale: Improvement #1 inherited (no carousel); eyebrow upweighting is D's bet

navHeader.treatment: every nav link rendered Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS — see typeScopeExpansions[nav]; current site has mixed 'Sponsorships' + 'NEW EQUIPMENT' inconsistency, D resolves to all-caps display plates

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: D's single bet is type-scope expansion using the captured family + weight. No invented fonts, no invented colors. The 1.333 ratio is within the brand-register hard rule (≥ 1.25). All-caps expansion is consistent with the captured surface (53% headings already caps, all CTAs caps).
